Reject anything older than five minutes. Failed deliveries are retried up to 6 times (1 min, 5 min, 30 min, 2 h, 12 h). Respond with any 2xx to accept.

settings.integrations.webhook.send: Send POST JSON with headers X-OrderRestro-Timestamp (unix seconds) and X-OrderRestro-Signature: sha256=HMAC_SHA256(secret, timestamp + "." + body). Items are matched by menu item name or id; prices always come from your menu. Send {"event":"ping"} to test — this card turns Connected only when a correctly signed event arrives.
